headlines.title: 3 Boring Stocks That Have Quietly Outlasted Every Bear Market of the Last 50 Years.
headlines.summary: Three unglamorous companies have kept raising dividends through every bear market since the 1970s, and the reason they survived has nothing to do with innovation or hype.

headlines.title: ARIZONA ATHLETIC GROUNDS NAMES PEPSICO ITS OFFICIAL SOFT DRINK PARTNER IN MULTIMILLION-DOLLAR INVESTMENT THROUGH 2033
headlines.summary: Arizona Athletic Grounds (AAG), one of the largest sports and entertainment complexes in North America, announced today a Founding Partnership with PepsiCo, naming the company and its product portfolio the official soft drink partner of Arizona Athletic Grounds. This seven-year deal carries a multimillion-dollar value through the length of the contract.

headlines.title: OAC Calls on PepsiCo to Keep Obesity Treatment Coverage for Employees
headlines.summary: The Obesity Action Coalition (OAC) is calling on PepsiCo to reverse its reported decision to end coverage of GLP-1 medications for obesity for some employees beginning in October.

headlines.title: Mondelēz, PepsiCo and pladis join forces for circular packaging trial
headlines.summary: The exercise will measure how the watermarking system works on wrappers, films and other plastic food packs.

headlines.title: Soda giant makes another warehouse change, cuts 105 jobs
headlines.summary: The latest move adds to four U.S. warehouse and distribution actions affecting hundreds of workers this year.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
